country.pick: Which country is fashion designer {label} from?
country.match: Match each fashion designer to their home country.
country.odd: Three of these fashion designers are from {value}. Which one isn't?
country.reverse: Which of these fashion designers is from {value}?

rows.label: Ralph Lauren
rows.hook: built a lifestyle empire on a logo of a mounted polo player and preppy looks

rows.label: Coco Chanel
rows.hook: popularised the little black dress and the boxy tweed suit, plus a perfume called No. 5

rows.label: Kate Spade
rows.hook: founded a brand famous for colorful, playful handbags

rows.label: Alexander McQueen
rows.hook: was known for dramatic, theatrical runway shows and skull-print scarves

rows.label: Yves Saint Laurent
rows.hook: introduced a tuxedo suit for women called Le Smoking

rows.label: Gianni Versace
rows.hook: built a flashy brand with a Medusa-head logo and bold gold-and-print designs

rows.label: Tommy Hilfiger
rows.hook: built a brand of red, white and blue preppy sportswear with a flag logo

rows.label: Christian Dior
rows.hook: launched the New Look, with nipped waists and full skirts, after World War II

rows.label: Karl Lagerfeld
rows.hook: was recognised by a white ponytail, dark sunglasses and high starched collars, while leading Chanel

rows.label: Marc Jacobs
rows.hook: headed the fashion lines at Louis Vuitton and made grunge a runway trend

rows.label: Vivienne Westwood
rows.hook: helped bring punk style from the street to the runway

rows.label: Vera Wang
rows.hook: is best known for elegant wedding gowns, after a start in figure skating

rows.label: Donatella Versace
rows.hook: leads a fashion house founded by her brother, known for platinum-blonde hair and bold glamour

rows.label: Giorgio Armani
rows.hook: made relaxed, unstructured tailoring a red-carpet staple

rows.label: Christian Louboutin
rows.hook: puts shiny red soles on high-heeled shoes

rows.label: Jean-Paul Gaultier
rows.hook: designed the cone-shaped bra corset Madonna wore on tour, and loves sailor stripes

rows.label: Tory Burch
rows.description: American fashion designer, businesswoman, and philanthropist

rows.label: Michael Kors
rows.hook: is a longtime judge on Project Runway and sells handbags marked with his initials

rows.label: Miuccia Prada
rows.hook: turned her grandfather's luggage business into a luxury house famed for a black nylon backpack

rows.label: Louis Vuitton
rows.hook: made travel trunks whose checkered, monogrammed canvas became a luxury status symbol

rows.label: Donna Karan
rows.hook: created the DKNY label and a capsule collection of seven easy pieces
